answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before entering the task market, then randomly audit clusters whose accounts submit near-identical work on tasks such as canyon, garden, and jetty. If an audit confirms coordinated duplicate identities, slash each account’s bond and withhold its queued rewards; independent agents recover their stake after review. A Sybil attacker must lock capital for every fake account and risks losing each bond, so scaling the swarm has an explicit funding cost rather than being free.
